items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-15
items.q: the only guy I didn't get a chance to hear too much, as I recall, was Kaiser Marshall. I don't think I heard him. Uh-huh. I heard, I might have heard him one time.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Did you see many of the changes in the personnel that you, uh, around observed when one guy came in and watch the difference in the band?
Uh, the only guy I didn't get a chance to hear too much, as I recall, was Kaiser Marshall. I don't think I heard him. Uh-huh. I heard, I might have heard him one time.
Well, who was the first guy to leave the band, out of the original?

items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: The interviewee corrects the interviewer regarding Kaiser Marshall, stating 'Not Kaiser' and later confirms Marshall was with the band 'one time' in the context of Bunk Johnson's troubles, but shows no personal interaction or relationship with Marshall himself.

ctx.x: Well, he was living with the Lofburrs, as I recall, most of the time. There was also a period when he was living with... Who was it? Kaiser Marshall? Yeah. Kaiser Marshall's apartment, was it? No. No. The other drummer. Not Kaiser.
